g.text: ArthurRank4Convo2 begins.

g.title: j1068179371
g.text: I'm worried about Eleanor.

g.title: j812191851
g.text: She knows.

g.title: j3203107679
g.text: I mean, that's your job as her brother.

g.title: j3978916033
g.text: She can handle herself.

g.title: j1270522854
g.text: BRB [End.]

g.title: j1322556044
g.text: I know she knows, that's the damn *problem.*

g.title: j1967412035
g.text: Try telling that to *her.*

g.title: j3661179963
g.text: Sometimes, I'm not so sure.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j3003384160
g.text: So?

g.title: j1759185576
g.text: I'm...not following.

g.title: j3831959978
g.text: Okay, brb.

g.title: j2135914505
g.text: I'm assuming you don't mean that literally.

g.title: j3933048025
g.text: She was born two minutes before me at a minute to midnight, and she thinks she's a hundred years wiser.

g.title: j2086642028
g.text: I just don't know how to help her anymore.

g.title: j1377607818
g.text: How do you help someone who can see past your words?

g.title: j537914869
g.text: Oh for f-- I didn't mean that bloody literally, mate.

g.title: j1225530235
g.text: No, I don't mean that bloody literally, mate.

g.title: j1162430138
g.text: She's hurting. And she's alone. And when she's like that...she goes dark.

g.title: j3103790119
g.text: We've always been on the same wavelength. Twins and all.

g.title: j3290586747
g.text: Wouldn't that make it easier?

g.title: j82028607
g.text: I can see why that'd make things harder...

g.title: j1838132386
g.text: And I don't mean normal dark. "Crystals and cards and ghosts" dark. I mean *pit of the void* dark.

g.title: j2788398887
g.text: It's one thing when you're twins and share a wavelength. It's another thing when she's literally *in* your thoughts.

g.title: j3710871267
g.text: When I need her to listen to reason, all she hears is *motives* and *feelings.*

g.title: j3431232767
g.text: Listening to your intentions rather than your words.

g.title: j3688431777
g.text: And you're worried someday she won't come back?

g.title: j1604511190
g.text: When I use Transference on Eleanor, I can hear what she hears. I don't blame her for having dark moments.

g.title: j3584472939
g.text: Yeah, not gonna lie, it creeps me out.

g.title: j2291409938
g.text: Can I make a suggestion?

g.title: j2810234427
g.text: I dunno, I think it's kinda hot.

g.title: j1567628438
g.text: How is that a bad thing?

g.title: j2386598682
g.text: Yikes.

g.title: j4226698698
g.text: Maybe that's more honest, but...complicated. Harder to convince her.

g.title: j995392776
g.text: I am. I can't lose her.

g.title: j737669341
g.text: I didn't even think about that...of course you can.

g.title: j980076390
g.text: She can't help it. And right now, we're her only friends.

g.title: j1197682176
g.text: Go for it.

g.title: j408369860
g.text: She can invade my mind anytime... :P

g.title: j22451230
g.text: You clearly haven't spent enough time talking to her, then. It's like she's got the bloody stage directions and I don't.

g.title: j2698093640
g.text: Exactly. It's like she's got the bloody stage directions and I don't.

g.title: j918574194
g.text: She's stronger than you give her credit for.

g.title: j2024262220
g.text: I'll help keep an eye on her.

g.title: j4275222239
g.text: Is she...okay?

g.title: j2008633656
g.text: She'll be fine.

g.title: j1958629536
g.text: Have you tried talking to her in this text app?

g.title: j1340747101
g.text: Have you tried telling her how hard it is to tell her how hard it is to tell her how you feel?

g.title: j15805651
g.text: AUGH

g.title: j2055633942
g.text: Trust me, I know how proper tough she is.

g.title: j205387324
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j88659995
g.text: As okay as someone can be, when her friends treat her like a monster.

g.title: j3673290535
g.text: As okay as she can be, when her own twin brother doesn't know how to talk to her anymore.

g.title: j342198170
g.text: She can hear every thought of everybody around her--and has to try to keep a straight face. I'd go dark now and again, too.

g.title: j3343041616
g.text: I'm not so sure. I don't think any of us can understand what she's going through.

g.title: j2826756335
g.text: Hard to read your mind that way. And sometimes it's easier to communicate in text. Case in point, look at us.

g.title: j2114179897
g.text: Okay, that sounded a lot smarter in my head.

g.title: j2350079229
g.text: She's my SISTER you BLOODY PSYCHOPATH

g.title: j2638192011
g.text: Anybody even half an ounce less capable would've snapped in half by now.

g.title: j879420568
g.text: Thanks. That means a lot.

g.title: j1045954321
g.text: That is...very fair.

g.title: j3610356218
g.text: ...Ouch.

g.title: j2678698977
g.text: Consider what Quincy thinks about when he thinks nobody's paying attention.

g.title: j3789597776
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j2619682073
g.text: I admit that did make me laugh, though.

g.title: j1331199349
g.text: Forget I started this damn conversation!

g.title: j4106771663
g.text: This is a lot to adjust to--she'll be fine.

g.title: j3924867532
g.text: Then trust her to come to you if she needs help.

g.title: j3886936528
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j111076220
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2792145570
g.text: I'd really rather not.

g.title: j2110993939
g.text: I...no. I didn't think of that.

g.title: j2313602363
g.text: So, good job on at least cheering me up a bit.

g.title: j1753394869
g.text: Maybe. But this is also something she's never had to deal with before.

g.title: j2169511884
g.text: Hard to be the outcast amongst freaks.

g.title: j3701904264
g.text: Deserved, but...ouch.

g.title: j3500072019
g.text: But point taken.

g.title: j3061281919
g.text: I'm going to try that. Thank you.

g.title: j2919152743
g.text: And I've tried that, but it doesn't work. She just shuts me out.

g.title: j2351671068
g.text: And I can't stand the idea of her dealing with this on her own.

g.title: j3809142591
g.text: What should I do?

g.title: j3921287064
g.text: Boolean ArthurEleanor is now true.

g.title: j3107498683
g.text: Hmm...have you tried texting her in the app?

g.title: j3308848041
g.text: I'd trust her to know when she needs help. She'll come to you if she does.

g.title: j4227295691
g.text: Some people want to deal with things on their own. Have you asked if she even *wants* help?

g.title: j2951033337
g.text: Have you told her *that* word for word?

g.title: j1256333535
g.text: Boolean ArthurEleanor is now true.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be ArthurEleanor.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be ArthurEleanor.

g.title: j3921287064->Chat ends. Next chat will be ArthurEleanor.
j745176033
g.text: Sometimes it's easier to express yourself in text, anyway. Less pressure. Easier to think.

g.title: j3229021778
g.text: She's my sis. I can't just let her suffer. I'll think of something on my own.

g.title: j1729344891
g.text: Boolean ArthurEleanor is now true.

g.title: j1761170315
g.text: I'd march up to her and give her a hug, personally. Let your emotions do the talking.

g.title: j2085326417
g.text: Talk to her on here. Hard to read minds through text.

g.title: j242708064
g.text: Just...be patient. If she needs you, she'll let you know. Some people need to heal on their own.

g.title: j3994439621
g.text: And that's when your twin *can't* read your mind.

g.title: j3978741539
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j1979829994
g.text: Might be overdue for one of those. Thanks, friend.

g.title: j2861539257
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2852898388
g.text: Fair point. Thanks, friend.

g.title: j3988886292
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j741066389
g.text: ...No. I don't suppose as I have.

g.title: j3207161583
g.text: Good idea. I'll try that. Thanks, mate.

g.title: j331802069
g.text: And...now I feel like a total knobhead.

g.title: j3207161583->Chat ends. Next chat will be ArthurEleanor.
j2594262057
g.text: I'll do that.
